description: One bench session, poll by poll, at the default 300 ms cadence. HAND-WRITTEN, NOT RECORDED: no PN532 has ever been attached to this code, so every field here is what adafruit_pn532 is documented to return, not what it was observed to return. Re-record this file from real polls the day a reader is wired up, and re-run deviceagent/tests against it unchanged.
